# Bounded acceptance, release and handoff records

## Handoff

Outcome; current scope/exclusions; current owner; fixed revision; existing changes/writers; actual evidence; unresolved failures/unknown effects; permitted next step; stopping condition; recovery reference.

## Acceptance

Contract; representative input; environment/provider if actually used; actual invocation; observed result and saved artifact; negative/cancel/restart cases where relevant; independent check; limits; evidence owner and revision. Clearly distinguish offline fixture, real integration and user outcome.

## Release readiness

Fixed source; reviewed diff; license and privacy audit; compatibility/migration boundaries; old active work drain or isolation; relevant acceptance; actual distributable checksums; rollback/recovery; authorized publisher; remote readback. Unknown or blocked gates stay visible. A checklist is not permission to publish or a substitute for execution evidence.
